    SELECT

    JOIN order_reviews orr ON o.order_id = orr.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE))) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

),
seller_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,

),
seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT * FROM seller_categories WHERE rn = 1
)
